title: Amulek introduces himself
summary: Amulek addresses the people of Ammonihah, identifying his father and ancestors, including Aminadi, Nephi, Lehi, and Joseph of Egypt.

explicit_facts.text: Amulek preaches to the people in the land of Ammonihah.
Amulek identifies Giddonah as his father and traces his ancestry through Ishmael, Aminadi, Nephi, Lehi, Manasseh, and Joseph.
Aminadi interpreted writing on a temple wall written by the finger of God.

unspecified_visual_details: Amulek's appearance, clothing, and age; the audience's size and appearance; the temple and its writing.

title: Amulek's standing and former ignorance
summary: Amulek recounts his reputation, family ties, wealth, prior ignorance of the Lord's ways, and rebellion until a stated date in the tenth year of the judges.

explicit_facts.text: Amulek says he has a good reputation, many kindreds and friends, and riches gained by industry.
Amulek says he had little knowledge of the Lord's ways and mysteries, but had seen the Lord's power in preserving the people.
Amulek says he hardened his heart, rejected repeated calls, and rebelled until the fourth day of the seventh month in the tenth year of the judges.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Amulek continues speaking to the gathered people.
unspecified_visual_details: Amulek's appearance and gestures; any visual representation of his past experiences.

spoken_dialogue.text: Nevertheless, after all this, I never have known much of the ways of the Lord,

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a specific preservation event or earlier call not described here.

explicit_facts.text: While journeying to see a near kindred, Amulek says an angel of the Lord appeared to him.
The angel instructed Amulek to return home, receive and feed a prophet who had fasted many days, and promised blessings to Amulek and his household.
